newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dongyang in 20.6-for-100 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Dongyang in 20.6-for-100 rights issue.

text.p: Dongyang Mechatronics Co Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to offer a 20.6-for-100 rights issue in November at a 20 percent discount to the base issue price, which will be set later.
Dongyang will issue 482,567 new common shares and allocate 20 percent of them to its own employees. The remaining 80 percent will be offered to the company's shareholders.
The offer will raise its paid-in capital to 12.1 billion won from the current 9.69 billion won, a company statement said.
Subscription is scheduled for November 18 and 19, with payment due on November 25.
